mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_summary (stat_date, category, pay_type, user_type, order_count, total_sales, user_count) SELECT #{statDate}, category, 'ALL', 'ALL', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{statDate} AND order_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY category UNION ALL SELECT #{statDate}, 'ALL', pay_type, 'ALL', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{statDate} AND order_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY pay_type UNION ALL SELECT #{statDate}, 'ALL', 'ALL', user_type, COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{statDate} AND order_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) GROUP BY user_type UNION ALL SELECT #{statDate}, 'ALL', 'ALL', 'ALL', COUNT(*), ROUND(SUM(total_amount), 2), COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) FROM orders WHERE order_time >= #{statDate} AND order_time < DATE_ADD(#{statDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
